newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Hung Kai & Co names Dew exec chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hung Kai & Co names Dew exec chairman.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd said on Friday it had revamped its board as part of its strategy to position itself as a leading financial services institution.
The company said Arthur Dew was appointed executive chairman, and Stephen Chong and Stephen Law were named executive directors. Gerard McMahon was named non-executive director.
The meeting also saw the exit of the company's former chairman and managing director, Tuny Fung, who did not seek re-election.

"The company will continue its drive to establish itself as a model of best practice in the industry in Hing Kong, and to provide the best possible service...for its clients and shareholders," Dew said.
Dew is a barrister and has been an independent non-executive director of Sun Hung Kai & Co since June 1996.
